prover.name: aesop
prover.wrapper: fun premises => do let clauses ← premises.mapM fun name => do let ident := mkIdent name `(Aesop.tactic_clause| (add unsafe $ident:ident)) let config ← `(Aesop.tactic_clause| (config := { maxRuleApplications := 0, maxRuleApplicationDepth := 0, maxNormIterations := 1000000000, maxSafePrefixRuleApplications := 0 })) let clauses := #[config] ++ clauses `(term| by intros; aesop $[$clauses]*)
